strategy.why: The card contradicts itself on price: its price fact says $120 while its priceCents says $1,200. At $1,200 the $5,000 target needs 5 sales (~50 contacts at the measured 20/200 conversion) out of 410 stations; at $120 it needs 42 sales, i.e. ~420 contacts against a market of 410, which does not fit. A contradicted price is not established, so neither OFFER_AND_PRICE nor MARKET_VOLUME is.

reviews.reasons: NO_PLAN is the right stance today. The single opening (cop_8b657f6bf2e849558519) has reach (410 stations in the regulator's database), demand, conversion on this offer's own sales (20/200 = 10%), Brain fulfilment, $10 cost, $0 exposure and 5 days to cash. The price is not established: the card's price fact (EVIDENCE) reads $120 while its priceCents is $1,200, and Brain's own link says 'no single price on the card'. The ten-fold difference decides the outcome. Recomputed: at $120, ceil(5000/120) = 42 sales are needed, but 410 x 0.10 = 41 expected sales x $120 = $4,920 < $5,000 — even contacting the whole market at the measured rate falls short (Brain's MARKET_VOLUME link fails on the same basis); at $1,200, 5 sales (~50 contacts) would carry it comfortably. The revision refuses to pick the favourable figure, names OFFER_AND_PRICE and MARKET_VOLUME as the decisive links, and gives a branch-specific resolution (read the amounts paid on the 20 recorded orders; at $1,200 re-plan EXECUTABLE, at $120 the target is out of reach at measured conversion). Nothing unknown is treated as known and no ledger is claimed.
findings: Arithmetic verified: $120 branch — 41 expected sales from all 410 stations = $4,920, $80 short (and $410 of direct cost makes net $4,510); $1,200 branch — 5 x $1,200 = $6,000 from ~50 contacts.

Weighting note: the $120 is the EVIDENCE fact while $1,200 is only the card's headline priceCents with no fact behind it; if the reconciliation cannot find a paid amount, the evidenced $120 should govern, which makes MARKET_VOLUME a true constraint (all the evidence cannot fit the target) rather than missing evidence.

The 20 earlier buyers came from 200 contacts that may overlap the 410 stations; because the service is quarterly they can rebuy, but the reachable pool of first-time contacts is at most ~210 if the 200 are excluded — this tightens the $120 branch further.
Research step r1 targets the decisive fact (amount paid on the 20 recorded orders) first — the cheapest way to settle the contradiction.
